results.title: Most followers on Instagram for a K-pop artist | Guinness World Records
excerpts:
# Most followers on Instagram for a K-pop artist
BLACKPINK singer/rapper Lisa (Thailand, b. Pranpriya Manobal; @lalalalisa_m) is the most followed K-pop star on Instagram, with 90,739,796 followers as of 24 March 2023.
All four individual members of South Korea’s BLACKPINK have around 70 million followers on Instagram, while the group as a whole have racked up some 54 million followers.
While she’s ranked below female musicians like Selena Gomez, Ariana Grande and Beyoncé, Lisa has more followers than any K-pop act and more followers than any musician – male or female – outside the Americas. Her nearest rival, Dua Lipa, had 87,744,852 Instagram followers as of the same date.
